Toss chicken and broccoli separately with oil, garlic powder, salt and pepper on a sheet pan.

options.name: Beef and Tomato Pasta
options.why: quick stovetop dinner using everything you have
steps: Boil salted water and cook pasta until tender, about 10 minutes, then drain.
While pasta cooks, heat oil in a pot over medium-high heat.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking it up, until no pink remains and it reaches 160°F, about 6-8 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes and a pinch of salt and pepper, simmer 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in drained pasta and toss to coat.
Top with shredded cheese and let it melt before serving.

options.name: Cheesy Beef Baked Pasta
options.why: oven does the work while you relax
steps: Preheat oven to 400°F.
Boil pasta until just tender, about 8 minutes, then drain.
Heat oil in a pan and cook ground beef until it hits 160°F, breaking it up as it browns.
Stir in chopped tomatoes, salt, and pepper, cook 3-4 minutes.
Mix beef mixture with drained pasta in a baking dish.
Top with shredded cheese and bake 15 minutes until bubbly and golden.
Let cool a few minutes before serving.

options.name: Beef and Tomato Skillet Melt
options.why: fastest option, one pan and done
steps: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add ground beef and cook, breaking it apart, until it reaches 160°F, about 6-8 minutes.
Add chopped tomatoes, salt, and pepper, cook 4-5 minutes until juicy and soft.
Sprinkle cheese over the top, cover, and let melt about 2 minutes.
Serve hot straight from the pan.

Fold in cooked rice, season with salt and pepper.

options.name: Spinach Feta Egg Scramble
options.why: fast and covers a big protein hit without a stove full of pans
steps: Heat olive oil in a nonstick pan over medium heat.
Add spinach and cook until wilted, about 1 minute.
Crack eggs into the pan and season with salt and pepper.
Scramble gently until eggs are fully set with no runny liquid, about 3 to 4 minutes.
Remove from heat and fold in feta.
Serve immediately.

options.name: Grilled Lemon Chicken with Chickpea Salad
options.why: closest to your protein for the day and lets the grill do the work

Grill chicken 5 to 6 minutes per side until internal temperature reaches 165°F.
Let chicken rest 3 minutes, then slice.
In a bowl, toss chickpeas and spinach with olive oil and lemon juice.
Top salad with sliced chicken and crumbled feta, serve.

options.name: Ginger Chicken and Bok Choy Rice Bowl
options.why: uses your chicken and bok choy together and stretches your rice for a solid dinner

ingredients.text: 12 oz boneless chicken thighs, sliced thin

steps: Cook rice if not already done and set aside.
Heat oil in a pan over medium-high heat.
Add chicken and cook, stirring, until browned and internal temperature reaches 165°F, about 6-8 minutes.
Push chicken to the side, add ginger and garlic, cook 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add bok choy and cook 2-3 minutes until just wilted.
Season with salt and pepper, toss everything together.
Serve hot over the cooked rice.

options.name: Crispy Tofu and Cashew Rice Bowl
options.why: gives you a plant-based option that still uses your rice and cashews for crunch

ingredients.text: 14 oz firm tofu, pressed and cubed

steps: Toss tofu cubes with oil, salt, and pepper.
Air-fry tofu at 400°F for 12-15 minutes, shaking the basket halfway, until golden and crisp.
Meanwhile, warm rice and stir in ginger and garlic.
Toast cashews in a dry pan over low heat for 2-3 minutes, watching closely so they don't burn.
Combine crispy tofu, rice, and cashews in a bowl.
Serve warm.

options.name: Chicken and Ginger Broth Bowl
options.why: a light no-frills bowl that clears out the bok choy and chicken with minimal cleanup

ingredients.text: 10 oz boneless chicken thighs, cut into chunks

steps: Bring chicken stock to a simmer in a pot with ginger and garlic.
Add chicken chunks and simmer until cooked through and internal temperature reaches 165°F, about 12-15 minutes.
Add bok choy in the last 3-4 minutes of cooking, just until wilted.
Season broth with salt and pepper to taste.
Place a scoop of cooked rice in each bowl.
Ladle chicken, bok choy, and broth over the rice and serve hot.
